Class ParseUtils

java.lang.Object
au.ellie.hyui.utils.ParseUtils
public final class ParseUtils extends Object
Utility methods for safe parsing of attribute values with optional debug logging.

    • parseIntAndApply

      public static boolean parseIntAndApply(String value, Consumer<Integer> consumer)
      Parse a string to an integer and apply it to a consumer if successful. This is useful for builder patterns where you only want to call a setter on success.
      Parameters:
      value - The string value to parse
      consumer - Consumer to apply the parsed value to
      Returns:
      true if parsing succeeded and consumer was called, false otherwise
